reviews.text: It pushed pet hair around the rug instead of lifting it into the canister.
The brush roll tangled with long dog hair after one room.
The suction dropped as soon as the filter had a thin layer of dust.
Emptying the bin released a cloud of hair and dust back into the air.
The hose attachment was too weak to clean hair from the couch seams.
It worked on hard floors but failed on the thick rug where my cat sleeps.
